NAM.note: Electronic notification from health facilities feeds registration of births and deaths; no records passing between the civil register and the ID system are stated.
The e-notification system from 135 health facilities is a notification channel; the document does not say births or deaths are registered digitally at registration offices.
Only counts of cards printed and collected in one outreach are given, not people enrolled against population.
No number at birth is stated.
Nothing on who builds, operates or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Lucia Witbooi said that as of 17 July 2024, 93,019 identity documents had been printed and 52,896 collected during the mass registration outreach to all 121 constituencies.

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security
Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Health and Social Services

facts.fact: Deputy Minister Lucia Witbooi said births and deaths from 135 connected health facilities are notified electronically, promoting accuracy of the data captured on the National Population Registration System (NPRS).

NAM.note: Health-facility e-notification is a notification channel; no digital entry at registration offices is stated.
